# Vendored source package

`panchang-ts-5.4.0.tgz` is the unmodified npm package tarball for `panchang-ts@5.4.0`, retained so `npm ci` can install the local calculation engine without registry access. SHA-256:

`59b5a56e93c2b41075db5b3a82c40a35ac43f20060ef50a3a5ebc81c9b510da5`

The package is MIT licensed and includes its licence file. Its upstream source is https://github.com/ishankgupta95/panchang . Audit notes are in `docs/ADR-001-PANCHANG-SOURCE.md` and `docs/DATA_COVERAGE.md`.
